title: The Lost Symbol
author: Dan Brown
summary: Robert Langdon is called to Washington, D.C., by an old mentor, only to find a grisly object left in the Capitol and his friend kidnapped. The trail runs through Masonic symbols and hidden places in the capital.
readIf: you want another Langdon puzzle-chase, set in Washington instead of Europe.
skipIf: you want the sharper pace of the first books; this one leans on big ideas.

pairings.reason: The series' best-known book, with a tighter chase and more famous art.
Another Langdon adventure that mixes a murder with a big question about humanity.
A slower, more atmospheric book about hunting secrets through old libraries and cities.
